title: event.capacities.patch
description: The capacities to set, one entry per timeslot. Each entry is matched to exactly one subEvent of the event on its `startDate` and `endDate`. SubEvents that are not in the list keep their current capacity.

startDate.description: The start date of the subEvent to update. Compared to the start dates of the subEvents as a point in time, so `2026-06-10T10:00:00+02:00` and `2026-06-10T08:00:00Z` match the same subEvent.

endDate.description: The end date of the subEvent to update. Compared to the end dates of the subEvents as a point in time, so `2026-06-10T16:00:00+02:00` and `2026-06-10T14:00:00Z` match the same subEvent.

allOf.description: The capacity of the matched subEvent. Replaces its current capacity. Send an empty object (`{}`) to clear it.
